# Context Governance Protocol (CGP)

> Open protocol and runtime for governed AI context: privacy, trust, provenance, purpose, policy and verifiable receipts.

Documentation: https://mrqwenty.github.io/fast-context-protocol/
Source: https://github.com/MrQwenty/fast-context-protocol

## Important limitations

CGP is pre-alpha. The core context planning protocol, privacy gateway and baseline conformance runner are reference implementations. Provider routing, EU policy compilation, Context Trust Firewall enforcement and zero-config proxy integration remain roadmap work. CGP is a compliance accelerator and evidence system, not automatic legal certification.
